set.body: Owner2026-10-28 selected compact storage under current limits. Introduce a portable exact-number/string/order-preserving structured-column representation and bounded row readers, with concrete instances and JVM/JS conformance/corruption tests. No defaultcap increase, no JSON-in-a-zip claim, no fullAST expansion during native readback, no lost logical rows. Measure actual retained corpus before enabling writer. Slice of g2-archive-scaling.
set.title: Bounded compact documents and row-wise codec restoration
